about.description: Synthetix is one of the longest-running DeFi protocols, founded in 2016 by Kain Warwick (originally as Havven) and now governed by the Spartan Council, a 7-seat elected council established by Referendum SR-2 in October 2024. Synthetix Perps (V3) is the protocol's decentralized perpetual product, currently live on Ethereum, Optimism, and Base, offering commodity perpetuals (gold, silver) margined in sUSD/USDC, with equity and equity-index perpetuals planned for 2026. The protocol pioneered synthetic-asset issuance via the SNX collateral model and remains a foundational liquidity layer for DeFi derivatives.
about.registryInfo: Synthetix was founded in 2016 by Kain Warwick (originally as Havven, pivoted to Synthetix in 2018; ICO raised ~$30M). The Synthetix Foundation, originally domiciled in Australia, was decommissioned in 2018 in favor of decentralized governance. Following Referendum SR-2 (October 2024), the protocol is now governed by the Spartan Council, a 7-seat elected council (1 treasury, 3 advisory, 3 hired Core Contributors). Synthetix V3 is deployed across Ethereum, Optimism, and Base.

fees.revenueNotes: Synthetix Perps V3 uses a maker/taker model with delta-neutral skew pricing. On crypto majors the published rate is 2 bps maker / 6 bps taker. RWA markets on Synthetix Perps are limited to 2 commodity perps; the platform does not publish separate fee tiers for these RWA markets, so the rate is presumed to follow the V3 general schedule. Trading fees accrue to SNX stakers. Source: https://docs.synthetix.io/exchange/perps-basics/maker-or-taker
